entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 64]
entries.label: coach_bb_brother_first_01

entries.text: 蓝莓联盟\n辛苦咯。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_01

entries.text: 多亏冠军换人了，\n紧张的空气缓和啦！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_02

entries.text: 阿若我啊～\n倒是也想和乌栗开心地相处……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_03

entries.text: ……但现实总是没有\n想象中的那么顺利啊～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_04

entries.text: 没关系！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 总有一天能行！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 不愧是现任冠军！\n真会说话！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_05

entries.text: ……最后弄得好像\n我利用了[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你一样。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_06

entries.text: 本来没打算这样的，\n结果我也稍微认真了起来。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_07

entries.text: 对于这一点，\n再次收下我的歉意吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp01_08

entries.text: 你这个联盟社社长！\n今天也在好好加油吗～？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_01

entries.text: 社长！？
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 怎么回事？
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 哎呀呀？我没跟你说吗？\n联盟社的社长……\c\n要由蓝莓联盟的冠军担任哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_02

entries.text: 我刚知道！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_03

entries.text: 没听说过
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_select_04

entries.text: 那真是失礼了！\n总之就是这么一回事儿！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_03

entries.text: 没关系，没关系！\n大家都会帮你的！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_04

entries.text: 我在实力最强的时候，\n也故意不要冠军的名号。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_05

entries.text: 让四天王的大伙儿\n轮流担任社长来着！\r\n……因为太麻烦了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_06

entries.text: 出了事儿有我帮你兜着，\n社长你就把心放宽～了吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp02_07

entries.text: 嗨，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们，\n之前跟你说的当社长那事儿……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_00

entries.text: “把工作全推给[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n 我觉得这样不好哦！”[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_01

entries.text: ……我被紫竽那家伙\n这样狠狠地训了一顿。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_02

entries.text: 至今偷的懒也被拿出来算账，\n结果就变成我来当了……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_03

entries.text: 加油！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 恭喜！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 恕我直言，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n阿若我觉得啊～不想加油～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04

entries.text: 哦哦！？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们，\n想不到你还挺会说话的啊。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_04b

entries.text: 啊～好麻烦～\n麻烦死了～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_05

entries.text: 你要是想帮忙了，\n随时过来领活儿干吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_sp03_06

entries.text: 说起来，社长的工作\n包括支援社员，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_00

entries.text: 这种小事的话，\n我倒是可以做一点～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_01

entries.text: 那么话不多说，开始支援！\n我们来交换宝可梦吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_02

entries.text: 够豪爽～！\n我的话当然是选铝钢龙！\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你要选哪只呢？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_03

entries.text:
是[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊，选得好！
不愧是冠军的宝可梦！\c
虽然我很怕麻烦，
但我会好～好照顾这家伙的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你要用[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n来交换我的铝钢龙，对吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_02_03

entries.text:
啊～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你现在不会
只有１只同行的宝可梦吧？\c
要是没有２只以上，
就没法交换哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_00

entries.text: 别说这种话啊～\n好不好！？配合一下嘛！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_03_01

entries.text: 你愿意配合了！？\n那好～我们来交换宝可梦吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_trade_04_00

entries.text: 嘿，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们，\n要和我对战吗？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_talkto_00

entries.text: 拒绝也不是坏事啊。\n啥时候都拼尽全力是会累的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_cancel_00

entries.text: 那好～\n差不多去对战场吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_00

entries.text: 哎呀，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们！\n我想和你打的是双打对战，\r\n再多带一只宝可梦来吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battlestart_01

entries.text: 和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你对战，\n真是太痛快啦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 为了表达平时对你的感谢！\n我有件礼物要送给你～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 在衣柜里放得都吃灰了。\n你收下它吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 嘿嘿嘿，\n上衣和我的一样哦～\r\n这就叫穿成一对儿啊！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从杜若那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]运动服套装（黑×金）[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_reward_00

entries.text: 你的实力又～提高了，\n不愧是我的[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 如果不经常和\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你过招的话，\r\n我都变得不能发泄压力了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
嘿嘿嘿！
捡漏赢了一把。\c
你就算觉得输了不甘心，
也别像乌栗那样走极端哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
你肯定以为我腰上的
是裙子吧～？\c
不是的～嘿嘿嘿～！
其实是围着斗篷哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
我啊，不太擅长理论课～
留了大概……３次级？\c
我比其他的家伙享受了
更长的学园生活，赚到了～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
椅子真是个好东西，
我爱死椅子了。\c
明明站着很累，
为啥大家都要站着呢？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_02

entries.text:
我和[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]哥姐们你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
相处得很好～\c
我会像对[VAR 0x0100(0000)]你一样
疼爱它的，你就放心吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我的铝钢龙只要身体光滑，
它就特高兴。\c
记得偶尔帮它
好好打磨一下～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_dragon_randomtalk_04
